This section includes minimal structured data. Refer to the Source Form Section for complete representation of the document. If additional discrete data is required, please contact the document Custodian.

A. Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation Orders.
Order Precondition Order Detail Procedure Goal Note(s)
Follow these orders if patient has no pulse and/or is not breathing. No CPR: Do Not Attempt Resuscitation. DO NOT Perform Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation
  • May choose any option in Section B.

B. Initial Treatment Orders.
Order Precondition Order Detail Procedure Goal Note(s)
Follow these orders if patient has a pulse and/or is breathing. Comfort-focused treatments Perform Comfort-focused Treatments Maximize comfort through symptom management; allow natural death.
  • Use oxygen, suction and manual treatment of airway obstruction as needed for comfort. Avoid treatments listed in full or select treatments unless consistent with comfort goal. Transfer to hospital only if comfort cannot be achieved in current setting.
Reassess and discuss interventions with patient or patient representative regularly to ensure treatments are meeting patient’s care goals. Consider a time-trial of interventions based on goals and specific outcomes.

C.Additional Orders or Instructions.
Order Precondition Order Detail Procedure Goal Note(s)
Betsy wants comfort-focused care and not extensive medical treatments or interventions
  • These orders are in addition to those above (e.g., blood products, dialysis).
EMS protocols may limit emergency responder ability to act on orders in this section.

D. Medically Assisted Nutrition.
Order Precondition Order Detail Procedure Goal Note(s)
Trial period for artificial nutrition but no surgically-placed tubes
  • Offer food by mounth if desired by patient, safe and tolerated.
